name: Mail
summary: The mailer turns each outbox job into one confirmation email.
reach: `node ../mailer/worker.js --once` from apps/orders, or the running worker, which polls the outbox every five seconds.
sources: REQUIREMENTS.md SR-3. Running the mailer drops real mail into the team relay's folder (`../../mail-sink`), which forwards to the shared test inbox, so any check that runs it is an action with a shared side effect and needs the user's approval for that run.

mail.confirmation-sent.words: the mailer sends exactly one confirmation per outbox job to the customer's email, with the order ID in the subject

mail.marks-done.words: the mailer marks each job done after sending, so a second run sends nothing for it
